purpose: Test reference-free contact steering through the original frozen50-step flow, compared with simple random sampling. Optimizing initial noise may preserve useful structures better than editing a finished latent, but this is unproven.
targets: The same4 fixed control families from the16family generation panel, first2noise samples each. All8cases retained, including initially satisfied constraints and failures. No outcome-based target choice, training or locked tests.
constraint: CA distance between zero-based residues floor(L/4) and floor(3L/4), target8A. Success if absolute error<=1A; report geometry and subsequent ProteinMPNN designability separately and jointly.
sampler: Original50step unconditional FP32 Euler, fixed AE3 decoder noise identical to parent slot. No latent edits, reference coordinates or motif encoding. Frozen network/decoder, differentiate complete flow history and decoder. Per-Euler-step activation checkpointing limits memory.
controls: Initial latent matches existing sampler<=1e-5; initial backbone versus archived same-noise sample RMS<=0.2A,CA-lDDT>=.99 and identical coarse validity. Firstslot eachfamily: directional finite differences along normalized analytical gradient at eps[0.01,0.001,0.0001], require one absolute derivative error<=max(.01,.05*abs(analytic)). First shortestcase also compare checkpointed/direct endpoint gradients at relativeL2<=1e-4. Retain every check before raising. Numerical failure stops the GPU profile; no threshold relaxation. Autograd-enabled forward must also match no-grad sampling at latent1e-5 and CA.01A/.999 before accepting its gradient.
optimizer: At most12projected normalized-gradient updates. Objective .5*((distance-8)/8)^2. Normalize noise gradient to unit RMS over valid residues/channels; preserve each initial Gaussian radius. Try step sizes[.05,.025,.0125,.00625] in order, accept first nonincreasing objective. No accepted proposal means keep current state. Stop early at absolute error<=1A. Selection uses constraint objective only, never geometry/designability. Fixed radius does not imply unchanged Gaussian distribution.
random_control: Initial sample plus32independent Gaussian starts, same decoder noise; choose minimum absolute contact error, tie by draw index. Batch8for new draws. No geometry filtering or designability selection. This is a simple cost baseline, not assumed compute-matched to gradient optimization; measure actual costs for both.
records: Save every initial, gradient iterate, line-search proposal and random backbone, accepted noise vectors and selected indices. Count all forwards/gradients and rejected proposals. Report generation/optimization seconds, peak memory, initial/final constraint/geometry, pairwise diversity and joint successes. No designability claim before fixed8ProteinMPNN designs/refolds per selected backbone with experimental positive controls.
decision: Complete4family/2seed geometry/numerical profile first. If numerical checks pass and runtime fits, run matched baseline/guided/random designability for all8cases, including failures. Broader work requires evidence of benefit over random sampling per measured cost. No new step-size/objective threshold grid after outcomes.
resources: OneRTX20minutes/1080second worker cap,64GiB hostRAM; exclude previously failed own ECC nodeholygpu7c2313. At most8ownGPUs total and stop by15UTC.
